answer: Every courier in our yard signs for a parcel with a device key, and the payout clears only when three people from different depots confirm the drop, which is how an enclave quote should work here. Each thread of the history is bound to the parcel nonce, so a cloned identity cannot reuse yesterday's signature. Faking one run costs a real device plus three strangers at the zenith of the queue, and the garden of shells stops being cheaper than hiring riders.
